$comment: Default core-allocation policy. Override per-site with --policy /path/to/policy.json
_smt: off => 'nosmt' on the cmdline and only primary threads are ever used. AMD 7a-family already ships SMT off; the flag is then a no-op.
_housekeeping: Per-NUMA-node cores for system.slice: systemd, sshd, agents, CloudWatch, kernel per-cpu work. NEVER isolated. cpu0 is always forced into this set.
_irqnet: Per-NUMA-node cores for irqnet.slice: NIC/NVMe interrupt handling, irqbalance, softirq. NEVER isolated, otherwise managed_irq steering has nowhere to land.
_shared_ratio: Fraction of each NUMA node's cores handed to the application as shared_cores (non-isolated, load-balanced). This is the pool for GC threads, JVM compiler threads, admin/HTTP endpoints, background compaction.
_l3_align: Round the non-isolated block up to a whole L3/CCX domain so exclusive cores never share last-level cache with housekeeping or IRQ work. Matters enormously on AMD (8-core CCX), less on Intel monolithic-L3.
_min_exclusive_ratio: Sanity floor: refuse to emit a plan that leaves less than this fraction of cores exclusive.
_hugepages_1g_per_node: 1GiB hugepages to reserve per NUMA node at boot. 0 disables. Sized for the JVM heap + direct buffers on that node.
_mitigations_off: Adds mitigations=off. Real latency win (5-30us tail on syscall-heavy paths), real security tradeoff. Off by default: opt in deliberately.
_idle_poll: Adds idle=poll. Removes C-state exit latency entirely at the cost of ~100% power draw and heat on every core. Prefer cstate_max=1 first.
_rcu_nocb_poll: Spawns polling rcuo kthreads instead of waking them. Lower tail latency for the isolated cores, more housekeeping CPU burn.
